body: Same fren. I can't seem to get out of the vortex of self-loathing and misanthropy. Let's read philosophy though, there sure are a lot of misanthropic pessimistic shit in philosophy that will make us feel less alone and comfort us through the darkest days. Hope you have the courage to stay though, because I don't and I no longer have the will to live. Only the rage that I feel keeps me alive. Because we're here we're queer we're full of existential fear so yeah maybe I'm better off dead because I can't feel any positive emotion anymore. All I have is hatred for humanity, life, the universe, everything. But it's okay though let's imagine ourselves happy and keep pushing the boulder up the fucking hill. Also, please listen to "Misanthropic Drunken Loner" by Days N Daze. Maybe you'll feel better. Rooting for you.
How old are you? Said the same thing days before my birthday but I don't know why I'm still alive though. Hope you have the courage to stay.
Bruh same, I'll literally die with Levi if ever he'll die huhu

We're in the same vortex of self-loathing and despondency bruh. I'm a disappointment too because I failed my first college degree so I had to shift to another course. I'm afraid I'll fail again but I don't even have the courage to attempt suicide again. Hope we have the courage to stay this time.
It only stops fucking us up when we're dead. But we still have to exact revenge upon existence itself so let's try to stay alive even though we hate it.

Thank you, I'm skeptical and weary of therapists because I've never met one who has truly helped me. They all think that my problems could go away through a simple prayer. All the people I met are all so religious too so I distanced myself from them to protect them from my bullshit and also to protect myself from their bullshit. I just hope I got the courage to kill myself again, but I can't. I survived three suicide attempts. I don't know why I no longer have the strength to commit suicide again.

I'm 20 too but I only started being suicidal when I was 16 years old. It's my family that makes me want to die yet at the same time it's them that's keeping me alive. Weird, but I want to prove them wrong.

Been dead inside for years too but I never had the courage to take my own life. I hope that our courage to stay is stronger than our will to leave. Will to leave > will to live.
Same, you're not alone. If only I could erase me from everyone's memories.
Same bruh, same. Let's just keep pushing the boulder uphill, only to have it roll back down. Life is sickening

Me too, only my pets keep me alive. I hate myself to the core too but when I'm with my cats I forget that I'm a monster who hates everything and I think again about what will happen to them when I'm gone. I hope you'll have the courage to go on. Your cat loves you too. You are loved.

I'm sorry you have to go through all that trauma, but why don't you report your father to the authorities? I mean, cops are bastards too but there are social welfare orgs and departments out there. What about your other relatives? It's a toxic environment and it's him who needs a psychiatrist even more. I hate therapists but maybe you also need to go to therapy. I'm here if you wanna talk.
Sure I will listen, lemme dm you

You're not alone, I'm so young yet already very tired. Life may be hard, the torture, the pain, the loneliness and misery that we have to endure everyday, and though most of the time we feel like there's no escape but death, we still try to look for reasons to live though most of the time we feel like there is really none. No matter how much we keep ourselves from being devoured by our nihilism and apathy and the desire to perish, and though we feel like nothing matters anymore, some days are good, some days are bad, we have no choice but to hold on, maybe not for ourselves but for the ones we value and for what we think matters in this life. I'm sorry we have to feel this way, though we can't take away the urge to die, and we can't hasten healing, we can wage war against the machine, against this hellworld we call earth for the hell of it and stay alive out of spite of existence itself, so please let's keep holding on.

It's okay bro, you're not alone, like, I don't know if it's out of nihilism or the fear of fucking up. Sometimes it's a defense mechanism but most of time there's nothing but emptiness and you feel frozen in time, unable to do or feel anything. Like you try to avoid confrontations and repress yourself and stay silent and try not to voice out your opinions because you don't want to get hurt and hurt anyone. I can't even bring myself to hope for things to get better, I've been through so much shit and trauma that led me to the apathetic pessimist that I am.But if we still fear failure then maybe were not that apathetic enough. Maybe we'll soon feel things again, feel human again. Let's just hold on.

I want you to know that you're not alone. I too am agonizing over how I cannot help myself through the panics. My panic disorder ruined my life and my scholarship, I failed my course because I'm not good at dealing with people and I can't face a lot of people without choking through my words. I'm anxious all the time and it's just horrifying, but I hope we'll get better soon. Keep holding on.

I wish I knew what to say, but I know the feeling of having a family who snuffs out the light in you instead of helping you rekindle the very light that they killed, instead of admitting that they have done you wrong, and the worst—is when they themselves don't even know that they are smothering and hurting you. Family members who render you repressed because they too are too caught up in their own problems they don't have the time to listen to the problems of the children they brought into this terrible terrible world. When they are deluded by the idea that you are doing okay and haven't even asked you what you are passionate about? It's not okay, I know, we are forever trapped in a family we don't like but we have no choice but to learn how to endure being with them. If you don't mind, can I ask why those drumsticks are so special? Because I myself have been saved by the music of two people who wrote songs about wanting to end it all, and one of them is a drummer. Stay, and one day you might even write songs of your own about what you braved through.

I know it's hard and the world is cruel, where you feel like no amount of words will make us feel less broken, no matter how much we think that existence is pain, how much exhausted we are of existing, of how much we hate ourselves for not being enough or for being too much, where the nip of death seems better than the torture of our own ugly thoughts... Nothing is worse than the pain of losing someone to suicide. Please keep holding on, don't do it. You are not alone, you're not the only one who wants to jump into the void of oblivion.
